b2-29-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Saying It Another Way
b2-29-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what it means that tomorrow's meeting is optional.
b2-29-01.prompt: Explain to Meg what it means that the meeting is optional, restating it in other words.
cues: Say that the meeting is optional
Restate it with a marker for other words
b2-29-01.target: La reunión es opcional; en otras palabras, nadie tiene que ir.
b2-29-01.english: The meeting is optional; in other words, nobody has to go.
b2-29-01.canDo: I can restate an idea with es decir, o sea, en otras palabras and dicho de otro modo.

b2-29-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Quick Correction
b2-29-02.scenario: You are Meg. You tell Carlos which day you arrived, but you say the wrong day and correct yourself. You arrived on Tuesday.
b2-29-02.prompt: Tell Carlos the day you arrived and correct yourself.
cues: Correct yourself with the right day (Tuesday)
b2-29-02.target: Llegué el lunes; mejor dicho, el martes.
b2-29-02.english: I arrived on Monday; or rather, on Tuesday.
b2-29-02.canDo: I can correct myself with mejor dicho.

b2-29-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Going Out Anyway
b2-29-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg says it may rain tomorrow. You still want to go out for a walk.
b2-29-03.prompt: Answer Meg: the rain does not change your plan.
cues: Say that you will go for a walk anyway
b2-29-03.target: Puede que llueva; de todas formas, vamos a salir a caminar.
b2-29-03.english: It may rain; anyway, we are going out for a walk.
b2-29-03.canDo: I can say that a doubt does not change what follows, with de todos modos, de todas formas and en cualquier caso.

b2-29-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Plan in One Sentence
b2-29-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos says your explanation of the plan for Saturday was long and asks for the main idea. The plan is cheap and easy.
b2-29-04.prompt: Give Carlos the main idea of the plan in one short sentence.
cues: Use a marker that promises a short sentence
Say what the plan is like
b2-29-04.target: En pocas palabras, el plan es barato y fácil.
b2-29-04.english: In a few words, the plan is cheap and easy.
b2-29-04.canDo: I can condense a long explanation into one short sentence with en pocas palabras and resumiendo.

b2-29-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Ways to Save
b2-29-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks how you can save money. There are many ways.
b2-29-05.prompt: Tell Carlos there are many ways to save and give one example.
cues: Say there are many ways to save
Give one example with a marker
b2-29-05.target: Hay muchas formas de ahorrar; por ejemplo, puedes cocinar en casa.
b2-29-05.english: There are many ways to save; for example, you can cook at home.
b2-29-05.canDo: I can give an example with por ejemplo, así and como.

b2-29-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Change of Plan
b2-29-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks when you leave for the outing at the weekend. You get the day wrong, correct yourself, and say that you are going anyway.
b2-29-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos the day you leave, correct yourself, and say you are going anyway.
cues: Correct yourself with the right day (Saturday)
Say that you are going anyway
b2-29-consolidation.target: Salimos el viernes; mejor dicho, el sábado. De todas formas, vamos a ir.
b2-29-consolidation.english: We leave on Friday; or rather, on Saturday. Anyway, we are going.
b2-29-consolidation.canDo: I can choose between restating an idea, correcting myself and brushing a doubt aside.
